components.name: Bs4QuartzCronComponent
Bs4UnixCronComponent
Bs5QuartzCronComponent
Bs5QuartzCronComponent
components.templateData:
<cron-container
  hostClass="c-quartz"
  [localization]="getLocalization()"
  [tabs]="getTabs()"
  [activeTab]="getActiveTab()"
  [hideTabs]="hideTabs"
  [schema]="schema"
  (tabChanged)="tabChanged.emit($event)">

  <ng-template
    #content
    let-activeTab>

    @if (activeTab === type.MONTH) {
      <quartz-cron-month
        [localization]="getLocalization()"
        [schema]="schema"
        (changed)="applyChanges()">
      </quartz-cron-month>
    } @else if (activeTab === type.MINUTES) {
      <quartz-cron-minute
        [localization]="getLocalization()"
        [schema]="schema"
        (changed)="applyChanges()">
      </quartz-cron-minute>
    } @else if (activeTab === type.HOURS) {
      <quartz-cron-hour
        [localization]="getLocalization()"
        [schema]="schema"
        (changed)="applyChanges()">
      </quartz-cron-hour>
    } @else if (activeTab === type.SECONDS) {
      <quartz-cron-second
        [localization]="getLocalization()"
        [schema]="schema"
        (changed)="applyChanges()">
      </quartz-cron-second>
    } @else if (activeTab === type.YEAR) {
      <quartz-cron-year
        [localization]="getLocalization()"
        [schema]="schema"
        (changed)="applyChanges()">
      </quartz-cron-year>
    } @else if (activeTab === type.DAY) {
      <quartz-cron-day
        [localization]="getLocalization()"
        [schema]="schema"
        (changed)="applyChanges()">
      </quartz-cron-day>
    }
  </ng-template>
</cron-container>

components.templateData:
<cron-every
  [label]="localization.quartz.hour.every.label"
  [schema]="schema"
  [checked]="api.isEverySelected()"
  [disabled]="cronUI.isDisabled()"
  [segmentId]="genId(mode.EVERY)"
  (selected)="api.selectEvery()">
</cron-every>

<quartz-cron-increment
  [label]="localization.quartz.hour.increment.label1"
  [label2]="localization.quartz.hour.increment.label2"
  [schema]="schema"
  [checked]="api.isIncrementSelected()"
  [disabled]="cronUI.isDisabled()"
  [segmentId]="genId(mode.INCREMENT)"
  [disabledControls]="api.isIncrementControlsDisabled()"
  [primaryOptions]="hourCodes"
  [secondaryOptions]="hours"
  [primaryValue]="api.getIncrementPrimaryValue()"
  [secondaryValue]="api.getIncrementSecondaryValue()"
  (selected)="api.selectIncrement()"

</quartz-cron-increment>

  [label]="localization.quartz.hour.and.label"

  [disabled]="cronUI.isDisabled()"
  [segmentId]="genId(mode.AND)"
  [options]="hours"
  [disabledControls]="api.isAndControlsDisabled()"
  [isValueSelected]="api.isSelectedAndValue"
  [selectValue]="api.selectAndValue"

</cron-and>

</cron-range>
